glance.question: Is Christian nationalism a defense of Christian civilization, an idol, or a label to drop?

positions.name: Christian Nationalism (Sympathetic)
positions.claim: A Christian people should shape its laws and customs as a Christian nation.

positions.name: Robust Christian Political Engagement (Anti-Nationalist)
positions.claim: Fusing faith with national identity is idolatry and compromises the gospel's witness.

positions.name: Theologically Chastened Engagement
positions.claim: Work for biblical convictions in law, but no nation is the kingdom of God.

start_here.title: What Is Christian Nationalism?
start_here.author: Paul D. Miller
start_here.why: Defines the term and sets it apart from patriotism, which Miller calls the love of country.

start_here.title: Larry Arnn and the Hillsdale Half Step
start_here.author: Douglas Wilson
start_here.why: Wilson argues that if nations are moral agents answerable to God, believers are Christian nationalists in substance.

start_here.title: “Christian Nationalism” Misrepresents Jesus, So We Should Reject It
start_here.author: Jonathan Leeman
start_here.why: Leeman wants biblical conviction to shape the law but argues the label misrepresents Christ.

key_number.text: Among white evangelicals, 31% say the federal government should declare Christianity the official religion; 57% say it should promote Christian moral values without one.
key_number.study: How Americans Feel About Religion's Influence in Government and Public Life

related.question: Should Christians seek political power or hold it at arm's length?
How should Christians respond when conscience conflicts with the law?

changes.text: added survey charts from Pew and PRRI, a definition and short answers to common questions.

notes: Voices checked in their own words, Nov 14 2026. Wolfe: Christ Over All transcript, Oct 20 2023 (https://christoverall.com/article/concise/transcript-interview-with-stephen-wolfe-on-christian-nationalism/): 'Christian Nationalism is a nation that recognizes itself as a Christian people and then wants to act in light of that.' Wolfe's voice page is noindex, so his name prints as plain text. Wilson: dougwils.com, Aug 25 2025: 'So my version of Christian nationalism is simply this. America needs to stop making God mad.' Moore: CT, Sept 2022 (https://www.christianitytoday.com/ct/2022/september-web-only/christian-nationalism-cannot-save-world-politics-elections.html): 'Christian nationalism is a liberation theology for white people. And that's not the gospel of Jesus Christ.' Keller: Christian Post interview report, Mar 12 2021 (https://christianpost.com/us/tim-keller-church-allowed-christian-nationalism-to-incubate.html): 'Christian nationalism works on fear and resentment.' DeYoung: Clearly Reformed (https://clearlyreformed.org/6-questions-for-christian-nationalists/): 'I am not a Christian Nationalist, but I almost could be.' Left off: David French (listed under Position 1 as a critic), Jenna Ellis, Voddie Baucham, Trillia Newbell, Derek Rishmawy, Ligon Duncan; see T1 report. Key number: Pew asks about government action, not the label; the PRRI chart is a separate scale.
